needs.why: Partly met. The cage stands at the camp's west edge, far from the fire and the longhouse, and Jeeta-Sakka is cast on the night guard. Its gate (Skyrim's cage gate with a Novice lock) and Sesk inside it are the quest's to place. But the camp's built walking mesh is cut off from the world round it, so the guards' patrols break and no one yet walks to the fire or the cage from outside.
needs.fit: The right spot: the edge farthest from the fire.
needs.narrow: Yes: the quest's gate at the cage's own place and turn; the camp's mesh joined to the world's (the walls or rocks that close it read and opened).
